reason: I already paid a creator once and got likes, not customers, so I'm not rushing back into creators just because the app is free. A beta from a small team I've never heard of could vanish next month, and my staff would have to learn a PIN system for nothing.
objection: Who are you? Free with no cut means I don't see how you make money, so either you disappear or you start charging me later. And creators who come through it are still the same creators asking me for free meals.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another café owner near me show real redeemed coupons and actual walk-in customers from a creator post through Mitra.
